categories.title: Workspace endpoints in the Accounts REST API

ai-gen.lead: Use workspace endpoints to manage granular access control within an account by configuring workspaces and their associated users, Connectors, and resources. These endpoints help isolate resources to enforce security and support organizational structures such as departments or projects. Typical actions include creating, modifying, and deleting workspaces, as well as managing their associated users and Connectors.
